steps.text: Wake up, leave your house and talk to Saria outside.
Collect rupees around the village until you have 40, then buy the Deku Shield at the shop.
steps.detail: Rupees respawn in the grass and under the rocks near the shop.

steps.text: Crawl through the hole behind the Know-It-All Brothers' house and open the chest for the Kokiri Sword.
steps.missable: Sample warning: nothing here is actually missable.

steps.text: Equip sword and shield, then talk to Mido to be let through to the Great Deku Tree.
Climb the vines to 2F and open the chest for the Dungeon Map.
Kill the Gold Skulltula on the vines of the 3F wall and grab its token.
Open the chest on 3F for the Fairy Slingshot.
Defeat Queen Gohma: shoot her eye when it turns red, then slash it.
steps.detail: She drops from the ceiling; stand back so her claw swipe misses.

steps.text: Take the Heart Container and step into the light to leave.
Cross the bridge out of the forest and talk to Kaepora Gaebora.
Learn Zelda's Lullaby from Impa in the castle courtyard.
Win the Cucco game at Kakariko for a bottle.
